title_options: What AI Automation Actually Is (No Hype, Plain English)
AI Automation Explained Simply — and Why I Built This Channel
Stop Ignoring the Boring Stuff: What AI Automation Really Is
description:
AI automation is just software that reads messy input and makes a sensible decision, wired to a task that runs by itself on a trigger. Put together: a boring job gets done automatically and you only check the result. This video explains AI automation in plain English with a real spreadsheet example — and why I built The Automation Desk.

Everyone chases giant AI systems and ignores the small, boring daily tasks that actually waste time: data entry, invoices, schedules, reminder emails. This channel is about automating those — tiny wins you can copy and scale to your own work. No hype. No guru act. No $49 course.

The loop behind almost every automation here: trigger → AI → check. A boring task shows up, the AI handles the messy middle, you glance at the result and approve it.
